class.name: IfcFlowStorageDevice
class.brief_description: The distribution flow element IfcFlowStorageDevice defines the occurrence of a device that participates in a distribution system and is used for temporary storage of a fluid such as a liquid or a gas (e.g., tank). Its type is defined by IfcFlowStorageDeviceType or its subtypes. HISTORY: New entity in IFC R2x. IFC 2x4 NOTE: This entity has been deprecated for instantiation and will become ABSTRACT
